title: My Son Forged A $164K Loan And Left Me Bedridden. So I Watched Him Lose His Food Truck
description: After 31 years as a school custodian, I had paid off my $190,000 bungalow, but my son used power of attorney during my double knee replacement to forge a $164,000 home equity line and buy a food truck. I proved the notary stamp was fake, got the lien voided, and seized the truck as restitution. Now Tyler scrubs the fryer at Equity of Betrayal Grill wearing a Home Equity Hustler shirt while every receipt prints the forgery docket. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #Karma
thumb_text: HE FORGED $164K NOW HE SCRUBS MY TRUCK
pinned_comment: What would you do if your son forged a $164,000 home equity line while you were recovering from double knee replacement and spent it on a food truck? If you have ever had family try to cash out your life, share your story in the comments.
